text:
A long indoor lab/workshop room with grey tiled floor, white walls and ceiling strip lights, plus exposed ducting and cable trays overhead.

Foreground: a white aluminium-profile conveyor or track frame running across the bottom of the frame, carrying flat white circular dish-like fixtures bolted onto metal plates; one is a taller white cylindrical cup shape, empty. A printed sheet with a black square fiducial/QR-style marker lies on the left rail.

Left: two black mesh office chairs on casters, one facing away; a row of stacked light-coloured chairs beyond, a grey waste bin, and wall shelves holding small bottles and containers.

Right: white bench cabinets topped with stacked blue and grey boxes and trays.

Centre rear: trolleys, carts, tables and equipment against the far wall. A large cardboard box sits on the floor at right.
